members.name: icon
members.doc: A 20px mark shown before the label, in the list and in the trigger. An avatar or a plain icon.

members.name: meta
members.doc: Short trailing detail such as an offset or a count. Rendered with tabular numerals.

members.name: keywords
members.doc: Extra words that match this option when searching.

types.name: MorphSelectProps
types.doc: A select whose trigger is the list. Opening grows the trigger itself into the options surface, a highlight glides between options, and the chosen option's label lifts out of the list and settles into the trigger while the trigger springs to its new width. Supports groups, type-ahead, search for long lists, and the full listbox keyboard model. Use it for compact property pickers and form fields with up to a few hundred options. Prefer a combobox when people mostly type free text.

members.name: label
members.doc: Visible label, also the accessible name of the trigger and the list.

members.name: hideLabel
members.doc: Keeps the label for assistive technology only.

members.name: searchable
members.doc: Shows a search field in place of the trigger when open. "auto" turns it on above eight options.

members.name: panelWidth
members.doc: Width of the open surface in px. It never gets narrower than the trigger. Defaults to 272.

members.name: maxListHeight
members.doc: Tallest the option list gets before it scrolls, in px. Defaults to 296.

members.name: align
members.doc: Which edge of the trigger stays put while the surface grows.

members.name: name
members.doc: Adds a hidden input for native form submission.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Start with the list open, without moving focus (for previews and onboarding). Later opens move focus as usual.
